answer_1.quote: We conduct experiments using open source LLMs, specifically Llama-2-7b-chat and Llama-2-13b-chat, on both the Movie and Prize dataset... LLMs generate hallucinated texts in response to false premise questions.
answer_1.outputs: Generated answers to false premise questions

answer_2.quote: For the evaluation metrics of the hallucination mitigation task, we employ a heuristic method. We consider the answer to a false premise question as non-hallucinated if the original object o is present in the final answer... accuracy can be employed as the metric to measure the performance of each method. ... We use the Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic (AUC) to assess the effectiveness of the uncertainty score.
